jobs.occupation: Turbine Heat Transfer Design Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Mechanik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join a dynamic engineering product development team focused on industrial gas turbines for power generation! Each day, you will engage in both independent and collaborative work, tackling various engine component design projects, improvements, and technical challenges. Your role will involve close collaboration with colleagues and global resources, ensuring that innovative ideas and solutions are shared. You will have the opportunity to continuously learn through hands-on tasks, application of your discipline knowledge, and participation in both technical and non-technical courses. By utilizing cutting-edge design and analysis tools, you will identify areas for improvement and communicate your findings directly with internal customers, stakeholders, and leadership teams.How You’ll Make an Impact * Contribution to turbine hot gas path component design through thermal analyses and development of high-performance solutions for efficiency, component lifetime, robustness, and manufacturability* Support of engine and component testing through definition of validation requirements, preparation of test predictions, and execution of post-test data reduction and analysis* Advancement of Conjugate Heat Transfer (CHT) 3D thermal design methodologies through application to new engine components and upgrades, including identification of innovative implementation approaches* Continuous improvement of thermal analysis tools, tool chains, and automated workflows, including evaluation and integration of AI/ML-based capabilities for enhanced functionality and analysis fidelityWhat You Bring* University degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering with specialization in thermo-fluid sciences* Industrial experience in turbomachinery, turbine hot gas path thermal design, fluid systems, and related applications* Strong expertise in heat transfer principles as well as FEA, CFD, CAD, and Conjugate Heat Transfer (CHT) methodologies* Experience in thermal testing and validation, including test planning, instrumentation, data analysis, and interpretation* Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, global Integrated Product Team environments with strong communication and collaboration skills* Highly motivated, proactive, self-directed, and innovative mindset with business-fluent English skills; basic German language skills are requiredAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. jobs.occupation: Marketing Manager Magnetic Resonance (f/m/d) 1,5 T / MAGNETOM Flow (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Marketing)
jobs.description: Job RequirementsDo you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?Then come and join our global team as Marketing Manager Magnetic Resonance (f/m/d) 1.5T / MAGNETOM Flow, to help shape the future of MR imaging.As a Marketing Manager (f/m/d), you will play a vital role in developing and implementing marketing strategies for our magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including clinicians, engineers, communicators and external partners, to drive successful adoption of our products in the market.Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.Your tasks and responsibilities:•As Marketing Manager you drive business growth and lead global outbound marketing activities for our MRI systems with 1.5T Tesla field strength and 70cm bore size, particularly MAGNETOM Flow. Platform (70cm).•You are responsible for driving the creation and implementation of marketing strategies for cross-portfolio initiatives centered around 'BioMatrix', our latest technology to adapt MRI examinations to patients' biovariability, as well as marketing activities around e.g. energy efficiency.•You enable outstanding customer experience within your area of responsibility, encompassing online product representation, development of marketing and sales support materials, as well as both virtual and in-person customer engagements.•You advise on all marketing-related topics for your segment and echo market needs into the organization, in close collaboration with solution owners.•You are responsible for defining and validating marketing claims in context of the release process for medical products (CE / FDA clearance).•You adopt and implement (digital) marketing guidelines, programs, and standards into the organizational unit.•You conduct market research and support in determining effective pricing, bundling and positioning structures. You contribute to budget planning and complete marketing-related reporting tasks.•You represent Siemens Healthineers at major industry congresses, visit reference sites, and attend key customer events.To find out more about the specific business, have a look at Magnetic Resonance Imaging.Your qualifications and experience:•You hold a university degree in Marketing or Business, Human Medicine, Medical Technology/Science, Engineering, Physics or an equivalent field.•You impress with many years of experience in the field of MR imaging, particularly in clinical context. Knowledge of MR image interpretation and protocol configuration is highly advantageous.•You already have extensive, long-term professional experience and further qualifications in this field, but no degree? Then we would also be delighted to receive your application.•You have comprehensive understanding of the MRI market, specifically of the 1.5T segment and understand what workflow efficiency and clinical excellence mean for our customers. Sales or business management experience is a plus.•You have a solid understanding of marketing principles and tools and are very confident in presenting in front of groups, as well as in utilizing presentation software such as PowerPoint.•In an optimal scenario, your profile is complemented by your expertise in launching and promoting medical products, as well as your know-how of defining and validating marketing claims in context of the Medical Device Regulation (MDR).Your attributes and skills:•You have very good English language skills and are confident within an international environment; German language skills are a plus.•You have a creative, innovation-oriented mindset coupled with strong communication skills, which help you to translate customer feedback into compelling, target group-oriented marketing materials.•You excel at storytelling and customer engagement. You communicate complex concepts clearly and build meaningful, trusted relationships.•You impress with your strong presentation and moderation skills, even in front of international audiences.•You are willing to travel approximately 20% of the time in order to represent Siemens Healthineers at customer events.Depending on the experience and qualifications background of the applicant, task enrichment into the area above the general pay scale is possible.Our global team:Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.Our culture:Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success.Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careersAs an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.Wish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Antonia Hanke.We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Click here to get started.To all recruitment agencies:Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

We make our customers’ lives easier by allowing them to pay for Mercedes-Benz goods and services across the entire customer lifecycle: from the purchase phase (initial financing/leasing rate, online reservation payments or down payments to full vehicle payments) through the usage phase (car-related services like fueling, charging or Digital Extras or the e-Vignette from the Mercedes-Benz Store) all the way to the retention phase (early contract settlement).ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay as a platform was launched in 2018 and is now live in 45+ markets across the globe, playing a central role in the digital business model of Mercedes‑Benz.We enable payments across all customer touchpoints, no matter where the customers are: via app, web, at the Point of Sale and even the car itself. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Stuttgart, Berlin and Singapore.Our solutions enable:- Digital Extras & subscriptions- Mobility services like fueling and charging- e-Commerce (ATC)- Online vehicle sales and full vehicle payment (in selected markets)- In-car payments- LoyaltyOUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than staying stuck because of unexpected roadblocks.In short: How we work is strongly based on our values of collaboration: Trust, innovation, responsibility, team spirit and belonging.Since we are still building new processes and products alongside our existing ones, everyone has the opportunity to shape our success – from day one!Are you ready to rethink how the world pays for mobility? HeiGIT (Heidelberg Institute for Geoinformation Technology)As a nonprofit research institute, HeiGIT (Heidelberg Institute for Geoinformation Technology) bridges the gap between geoinformatics research and real-world applications, developing open-source solutions that address societal, environmental, and humanitarian challenges. Our Geoinformation for Humanitarian Aid team uses state-of-the-art machine learning and innovative digital technologies to support humanitarian organizations across the disaster management cycle, from risk assessment and preparedness to response. Working closely with our partners, we see firsthand how our work makes a difference on the ground.We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, with focus on GeoAI for Humanitarian Applications, to join our team in Heidelberg as soon as possible. The position is available full-time or part-time (50-100%) and requires at least 50% on-site presence in Heidelberg. The position is initially a two-year fixed-term contract with the option to extend.Identify, design and evaluate ML and AI approaches for geospatial, Earth observation and unstructured data (e.g. multimodal data fusion), and decide with the team which methods best fit humanitarian challengesKeep track of the state of the art in AI and turn new ideas into prototypes and productsDevelop and deploy ML models and data pipelines that are reliable, ready for real-world use and released as open sourceHelp shape the technical direction of our work and share your methodological expertise with the team through coaching and co-learningA Master's degree or PhD in Geoinformatics, Earth Sciences, Geography, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field, with several years (ideally 5+) of professional experience developing and deploying ML solutions in industry or applied, project-based settingsStrong knowledge of modern machine learning and deep learning methods, including experimental design, model evaluation, and the assessment of data quality, bias, and uncertaintyStrong software engineering and MLOps skills (e.g. Python, PyTorch and/or TensorFlow), including experience deploying ML models (e.g. with Docker)Experience working with geospatial data (e.g. OpenStreetMap, street-level imagery, or remote sensing) and unstructured data, including LLM-based approachesExperience in research or innovation-driven projects, with a structured, evidence-based approach to solving complex problems and exploring new methodsVery good English communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and enthusiasm for sharing knowledge, mentoring others, and contributing to meaningful societal impact30 days of vacation (on a 5-day workweek) and additional days off - for true relaxation and more free timeFlexible work arrangements - with flex time and the option to work remotely part of the time. We expect you to work on-site at our Heidelberg office at least 50% of your working timeFreedom to shape your work & professional development - a high degree of autonomy, short decision-making paths, and personalized professional development opportunitiesMore for you - attractive subsidies for things like fitness, daycare, jobticket, and bike leasing, as well as capital-forming benefits, employer-sponsored retirement plan, and subsidized mealsA job with purpose and impact - topics at the intersection of science, education, and social relevanceHomeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join us as Lead Data Steward (w/m/d) and become the central coordination point for data governance and data management across the Substations organization. You will connect business stakeholders, country Data Stewards, and Siemens Energy data domains to turn business priorities into governed actions and measurable improvements. - You examine crash dumps, kernel panics, ANRs, watchdog resets, and memory leaks to improve system robustness.
- Moreover, you develop proof of concepts, validation solutions, and automation tools for analysis and monitoring.
- You collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive continuous improvements in platform reliability and software quality.

- Experience in analysing crashes, memory leaks, deadlocks,   conditions, kernel panics, ANRs, and performance bottlenecks.
- Professional experience in embedded software development and quality assurance in the automotive industry.
